name: infrastructure-report
title: Report on infrastructure assets
for_each: select 'organisation' as id, setting('organisation', 'Your organisation') as name

sections.title: Assets by class
sections.note: Gross replacement cost, written down value and annual depreciation from the register; backlog is the cost to renew assets below a satisfactory condition.
sections.sql: select r.class_code as class, r.class as name, sum(r.grc_cents)::bigint as gross_replacement_cents, sum(r.carrying_cents)::bigint as written_down_value_cents, sum(r.annual_depreciation_cents)::bigint as annual_depreciation_cents, coalesce(sum(r.grc_cents) filter (where r.grade >= r.intervention_grade), 0)::bigint as backlog_cents, max(c.required_maintenance_cents) as required_maintenance_cents, max(r.currency) as currency from asset_register r join asset_classes c on c.id = r.class_id where $1 = 'organisation' group by r.class_code, r.class order by r.class_code

sections.title: Condition, as a share of gross replacement cost
sections.note: Grade 1 excellent to grade 5 very poor.
sections.sql: select class_code as class, grade_1_percent, grade_2_percent, grade_3_percent, grade_4_percent, grade_5_percent, not_graded_percent from condition_profile where $1 = 'organisation' order by class_code

sections.title: Ratios
sections.note: Renewals and the essential services ratio against depreciation; maintenance against required maintenance; backlog against written down value. Past years actual, later years budget.
sections.sql: select fy_label(financial_year) as year, basis, renewals_ratio_percent, essential_services_percent, maintenance_ratio_percent, backlog_ratio_percent from ratios where $1 = 'organisation'

name: class-summary
title: Asset class summary
for_each: select c.id::text as id, c.code || ' ' || c.name as name from asset_classes c where exists (select 1 from assets a where a.class_id = c.id and a.status = 'active') order by c.code

sections.title: The class
sections.sql: select c.code, c.name, c.category, c.unit, c.default_useful_life_years as useful_life_years, c.inspection_months, c.revaluation_years, c.last_revalued_on, (select sum(grc_cents) from asset_register r where r.class_id = c.id)::bigint as grc_cents, setting('currency', 'NZD') as currency from asset_classes c where c.id::text = $1

sections.title: Assets
sections.sql: select code, name, area, quantity, unit, grc_cents, age_years, grade, remaining_life_years, criticality, currency from asset_register where class_id::text = $1 order by code

sections.title: Renewals in the next 10 years
sections.sql: select fy_label(f.financial_year) as year, f.code, f.name, f.grade, f.cost_cents, f.currency from renewal_forecast f join asset_classes c on c.code = f.class_code where c.id::text = $1 and f.financial_year < fy_of(current_date) + 10 order by f.financial_year

sections.title: Works programme
sections.sql: select number, name, kind, fy_label(financial_year) as year, budget_cents, actual_cents, status, currency from works_list where class_id::text = $1 order by financial_year, number

name: renewal-programme
title: Ten-year renewal programme
for_each: select 'organisation' as id, setting('organisation', 'Your organisation') as name

sections.title: By year and class
sections.note: Forecast from each asset's condition and useful life. Assets already below satisfactory fall in the first year.
sections.sql: select fy_label(financial_year) as year, class_code as class, count(*) as renewals, sum(cost_cents)::bigint as cost_cents, max(currency) as currency from renewal_forecast where $1 = 'organisation' and financial_year < fy_of(current_date) + 10 group by financial_year, class_code order by financial_year, class_code

sections.title: Against the budget
sections.sql: select fy_label(financial_year) as year, forecast_cents, budget_cents, gap_cents, cumulative_gap_cents, currency from funding_gap where $1 = 'organisation' and financial_year < fy_of(current_date) + 10 order by financial_year

name: revaluation-schedule
title: Revaluation schedule
for_each: select c.id::text as id, c.code || ' ' || c.name as name from asset_classes c join revaluations_due d on d.code = c.code where d.assets > 0 and d.due_on < current_date + 365 order by d.due_on

sections.title: For the valuer
sections.note: Every asset in the class with its measure, unit rate, dates, life and condition. Depreciated replacement cost, straight line.
sections.sql: select code, name, area, quantity, unit, unit_rate_cents, grc_cents, installed_on, renewed_on, useful_life_years, grade, accumulated_depreciation_cents, carrying_cents, currency from asset_register where class_id::text = $1 order by code

sections.title: Previous valuations
sections.sql: select valued_on, valuer, method, index_pct, gross_replacement_cents, accumulated_depreciation_cents, annual_depreciation_cents, setting('currency', 'NZD') as currency from valuations where class_id::text = $1 order by valued_on desc

name: defect-instruction
title: Defect work instruction
for_each: select id::text as id, number || ' ' || asset as name from defects_open where status = 'open' order by respond_by

sections.title: The defect
sections.sql: select d.number, d.risk, d.reported_on, d.respond_by, d.description from defects_open d where d.id::text = $1

sections.title: Where
sections.sql: select a.code, a.name, a.location, a.area, c.name as class, a.criticality from defects d join assets a on a.id = d.asset_id join asset_classes c on c.id = a.class_id where d.id::text = $1

sections.title: Recent inspections of this asset
sections.sql: select i.inspected_on, i.grade, i.inspector, i.notes from inspections i join defects d on d.asset_id = i.asset_id where d.id::text = $1 order by i.inspected_on desc limit 3
